title: tutor — minibus

sentences.sentence: The children were educated at home by a succession of tutors.
sentences.translation: 这些孩子在家接受教育，连续请过几任家庭教师。

sentences.sentence: She was my tutor at Durham.
sentences.translation: 她是我在达勒姆大学时的导师。

sentences.sentence: The college has revised its plans because of local objections.
sentences.translation: 由于地方上的反对，学院已经修改了计划。

sentences.sentence: We have revised our estimates of population growth.
sentences.translation: 我们已修正了对人口增长的估计。

sentences.sentence: I’ve got to revise my geography.
sentences.translation: 我得复习一下地理。

sentences.sentence: The judge wants to see a revision of the procedures.
sentences.translation: 法官希望对程序进行修改。

sentences.sentence: I know I haven’t done enough revision for tomorrow’s exam.
sentences.translation: 我知道我对明天的考试准备不足。

phrases.translation: 抽风机；通风机；通气风扇
(啤酒)散装的，可从容器中随时直接汲出的

sentences.sentence: the rough draft of his new novel
sentences.translation: 他的新小说的草稿

sentences.sentence: I read the first draft and thought it was very good.
sentences.translation: 我读了第一稿，觉得非常好。

sentences.sentence: All parties eventually approved the final draft (= finished form ) of the peace treaty.
sentences.translation: 各方最后都同意了和平条约的终稿。

sentences.sentence: Eva’s busy drafting her speech for the conference.
sentences.translation: 伊娃正忙着起草她的大会发言稿。

sentences.sentence: My fingers were so numb I could hardly write.
sentences.translation: 我的手指麻木得几乎没法写字。

sentences.sentence: The anaesthetic made his whole face go numb.
sentences.translation: 麻醉剂使他整个脸都失去了知觉。

sentences.sentence: The family acknowledge the need for change.
sentences.translation: 全家人都承认需要改变一下。

sentences.sentence: Claire acknowledged that she was guilty.
sentences.translation: 克莱尔承认有罪。

sentences.sentence: The government must acknowledge what is happening and do something about it.
sentences.translation: 对于目前的情况，政府必须承认其存在并对此采取措施。

sentences.sentence: ‘Maybe you are right,’ she acknowledged.
sentences.translation: “也许你是对的。”她承认道。

sentences.sentence: This is a fact that most smokers readily acknowledge .
sentences.translation: 这是大多数烟民都愿意承认的事实。

sentences.sentence: We wish to acknowledge the support of the university.
sentences.translation: 我们想要感谢大学给予的支持。

entries.word: as far as one is concerned

sentences.sentence: Deborah opened her mouth to contradict, but closed it again.
sentences.translation: 黛博拉张口想要反驳，但又把嘴闭上了。

sentences.sentence: Dad just can’t bear to be contradicted.
sentences.translation: 爸爸就是受不了有人反驳他。

sentences.sentence: The article flatly contradicts their claims.
sentences.translation: 这篇文章断然驳斥他们的说法。

sentences.sentence: They proudly declared themselves part of a new autonomous province.
sentences.translation: 他们自豪地宣布自己是新自治省的一部分。

sentences.sentence: He treated us as autonomous individuals who had to learn to make up our own minds about issues.
sentences.translation: 他视我们为独立个体，必须学会自主处理问题。

sentences.sentence: He occupies the house without paying any rent.
sentences.translation: 他住在这幢房子里，没有付一分钱房租。

sentences.sentence: The building was purchased and occupied by its new owners last year.
sentences.translation: 这幢房屋去年被新业主买下入住了。

sentences.sentence: Family photos occupied almost the entire wall.
sentences.translation: 家人的照片差不多占了整个墙面。

sentences.sentence: Students occupied Sofia University on Monday.
sentences.translation: 星期一学生们占领了索非亚大学。

sentences.sentence: She’s fully occupied with work.
sentences.translation: 工作使她忙得不可开交。

phrases.translation: 龙头企业；（行业中的）龙头老大

sentences.sentence: We’re looking for young people with enterprise and creativity.
sentences.translation: 我们在寻找有事业心和创造力的年轻人。

phrases.translation: 不像样的代替品，勉强充作某物的东西，滥竽充数的样品[用于贬义]

sentences.sentence: The minister had to issue a formal public apology for his remarks.
sentences.translation: 部长不得不为他的言论作出正式的公开道歉。

sentences.sentence: Publishers and writers from 13 countries attended the seminar .
sentences.translation: 来自13个国家的出版商和作家参加了此次研讨会。

sentences.sentence: Your wristwatch videophone suddenly rings.
sentences.translation: 突然，你手表上的可视电话响了。

translations.translation: 未婚男子；获学士学位的人

phrases.translation: 学士学位；大学本科学位证书
（美）单身汉舞会（尤指婚礼前夕为新郎举行的）

sentences.sentence: Gerald was 38, and a confirmed bachelor (=  a man who has decided that he will never marry  ) .
sentences.translation: 杰拉德38岁，抱定主意独身。

sentences.sentence: The Crown Prince was Japan’s most eligible bachelor (=  a rich young man who has not yet married  ) .
sentences.translation: 皇太子是日本最理想的适婚男子。

sentences.sentence: If you are under 26, a graduate with a bachelor’s degree or above, unmarried and have a stable job in Shenzhen, all you need is an identification card, education and working certificate.
sentences.translation: 如果你年龄在26岁以下，拥有本科及以上学历，单身未婚，并且在深圳有稳定的工作，你所需要的仅仅是身份证，学历证书以及工作证明就可以了。

phrases.translation: 定期试验；常规试验；例行程序试验；定期测验
例行检查；常规检查；日常检验

sentences.sentence: John’s departure had upset their daily routine .
sentences.translation: 约翰的离去打乱了他们的日常生活。

sentences.sentence: Try to get into a routine (= develop a fixed order of doing things ) .
sentences.translation: 尽量养成一套习惯。

sentences.sentence: my daily exercise routine
sentences.translation: 我每天的锻炼习惯

sentences.sentence: Dressing is a task which we do every day as a matter of routine (= done regularly and not unusual ) .
sentences.translation: 穿衣打扮是我们每天必做的事情。

sentences.sentence: You mustn’t worry. These are just routine enquiries.
sentences.translation: 你不必担心，这只是例行的询问。

sentences.sentence: He was then taken by minibus to the military base.
sentences.translation: 接着他被小型公共汽车带到了军事基地。

text:
英语词汇 · 人教高中 · 第 120 单元

tutor
音标：英 /'tjuːtə/  美 /'tʊtɚ/
n. 家庭教师；导师；助教
短语：private tutor — 私人教师，家庭教师
短语：tutor system — 导师制
例句：The children were educated at home by a succession of tutors.
这些孩子在家接受教育，连续请过几任家庭教师。
例句：She was my tutor at Durham.
她是我在达勒姆大学时的导师。

revise
音标：英 /rɪ'vaɪz/  美 /rɪ'vaɪz/
v. 复查；修正；复习
短语：revise for — v. 复习功课（迎考）
例句：The college has revised its plans because of local objections.
由于地方上的反对，学院已经修改了计划。
例句：We have revised our estimates of population growth.
我们已修正了对人口增长的估计。
例句：I’ve got to revise my geography.
我得复习一下地理。

revision
音标：英 /rɪ'vɪʒ(ə)n/  美 /rɪ'vɪʒən/
n. 复查；修正；复习
短语：general revision — 总复习
例句：The judge wants to see a revision of the procedures.
法官希望对程序进行修改。
例句：I know I haven’t done enough revision for tomorrow’s exam.
我知道我对明天的考试准备不足。

draft
音标：英 /drɑːft/  美 /dræft/
n. 草稿；草案
v. 草拟；起草
短语：first draft — 初稿
短语：draft at — 汇票期限
短语：draft resolution — 提案；决议草案
短语：sight draft — [经]即期汇票
短语：draft tube — 尾水管；通风管；引流管
短语：draft at sight — 即期汇票
短语：draft contract — 合同草案
短语：draft beer — 生啤酒
短语：bank draft — [经]银行汇票，银行票据
短语：draft fan — 抽风机；通风机；通气风扇
短语：rough draft — 草稿；底子
短语：induced draft — 诱导通风；进气通风
短语：on draft — (啤酒)散装的，可从容器中随时直接汲出的
短语：induced draft fan — 引风机；抽风式风扇
短语：draft out — 起草
短语：draft plan — 草图，草案
短语：documentary draft — 跟单汇票；押汇汇票
短语：natural draft — 自然通风
短语：time draft — 定期汇票
短语：final draft — 最终稿，正稿
例句：the rough draft of his new novel
他的新小说的草稿
例句：I read the first draft and thought it was very good.
我读了第一稿，觉得非常好。
例句：All parties eventually approved the final draft (= finished form ) of the peace treaty.
各方最后都同意了和平条约的终稿。
例句：Eva’s busy drafting her speech for the conference.
伊娃正忙着起草她的大会发言稿。

numb
音标：英 /nʌm/  美 /nʌm/
adj. 麻木的；失去知觉的
例句：My fingers were so numb I could hardly write.
我的手指麻木得几乎没法写字。
例句：The anaesthetic made his whole face go numb.
麻醉剂使他整个脸都失去了知觉。

acknowledge
音标：英 /ək'nɒlɪdʒ/  美 /ək'nɑlɪdʒ/
v. 承认；确认；答谢
短语：acknowledge receipt — 证实收到
短语：acknowledge receipt of — 收到
例句：The family acknowledge the need for change.
全家人都承认需要改变一下。
例句：Claire acknowledged that she was guilty.
克莱尔承认有罪。
例句：The government must acknowledge what is happening and do something about it.
对于目前的情况，政府必须承认其存在并对此采取措施。
例句：‘Maybe you are right,’ she acknowledged.
“也许你是对的。”她承认道。
例句：This is a fact that most smokers readily acknowledge .
这是大多数烟民都愿意承认的事实。
例句：We wish to acknowledge the support of the university.
我们想要感谢大学给予的支持。

as far as one is concerned
就……而言

contradict
音标：英 /kɒntrə'dɪkt/  美 /'kɑntrə'dɪkt/
v. 反驳；反斥
短语：contradict oneself — 自相矛盾
例句：Deborah opened her mouth to contradict, but closed it again.
黛博拉张口想要反驳，但又把嘴闭上了。
例句：Dad just can’t bear to be contradicted.
爸爸就是受不了有人反驳他。
例句：The article flatly contradicts their claims.
这篇文章断然驳斥他们的说法。

autonomous
音标：英 /ɔː'tɒnəməs/  美 /ɔ'tɑnəməs/
adj. 自治的；自主的；独立的
短语：autonomous region — 自治区
短语：autonomous county — 自治县
短语：autonomous prefecture — 自治州
短语：autonomous system — 自治系统；独立系统
短语：autonomous operation — 独立作战；自仲作
例句：They proudly declared themselves part of a new autonomous province.
他们自豪地宣布自己是新自治省的一部分。
例句：He treated us as autonomous individuals who had to learn to make up our own minds about issues.
他视我们为独立个体，必须学会自主处理问题。

occupy
音标：英 /'ɒkjʊpaɪ/  美 /'ɑkjupaɪ/
v. 占据；占用；占领
短语：occupy in — 从事
例句：He occupies the house without paying any rent.
他住在这幢房子里，没有付一分钱房租。
例句：The building was purchased and occupied by its new owners last year.
这幢房屋去年被新业主买下入住了。
例句：Family photos occupied almost the entire wall.
家人的照片差不多占了整个墙面。
例句：Students occupied Sofia University on Monday.
星期一学生们占领了索非亚大学。

be occupied with
忙着做……；忙于某事物
例句：She’s fully occupied with work.
工作使她忙得不可开交。

enterprise
音标：英 /'entəpraɪz/  美 /'ɛntɚ'praɪz/
n. 事业；事业心
短语：enterprise management — 企业管理
短语：business enterprise — 工商企业；企业机构
短语：private enterprise — 民营企业；私营企业
短语：enterprise culture — 企业文化
短语：enterprise group — 企业集团
短语：modern enterprise management — 现代企业管理
短语：foreign enterprise — 外资企业；国外企业
短语：enterprise value — 企业价值
短语：leading enterprise — 龙头企业；（行业中的）龙头老大
短语：logistics enterprise — 物流企业
短语：industrial enterprise — 工业企业
短语：enterprise network — 企业网络；企业网路
短语：enterprise resource planning — 企业资源规划
短语：enterprise accounting — [经]企业会计
短语：state enterprise — 国营企业
短语：joint venture enterprise — 合资企业
短语：export enterprise — 出口企业
短语：key enterprise — 骨干企业
短语：enterprise financing — 企业理财
短语：enterprise standard — 企业标准
例句：We’re looking for young people with enterprise and creativity.
我们在寻找有事业心和创造力的年轻人。

apology
音标：英 /ə'pɒlədʒɪ/  美 /ə'pɑlədʒi/
n. 道谦；谢罪
短语：an apology for something — 不像样的代替品，勉强充作某物的东西，滥竽充数的样品[用于贬义]
短语：a poor apology — 有名无实
短语：make an apology — 道歉
例句：The minister had to issue a formal public apology for his remarks.
部长不得不为他的言论作出正式的公开道歉。

seminar
音标：英 /'semɪnɑː/  美 /'sɛmɪnɑr/
n. （专题）研讨会
短语：seminar course — 研究科目；研究学程
例句：Publishers and writers from 13 countries attended the seminar .
来自13个国家的出版商和作家参加了此次研讨会。

videophone
音标：英 /'vɪdɪə(ʊ)fəʊn/  美 /'vɪdɪofon/
n. 可视电话
例句：Your wristwatch videophone suddenly rings.
突然，你手表上的可视电话响了。

Rugby
音标：英 /'rʌgbɪ/  美 /'rʌɡbi/
n. （英式）橄榄球
短语：rugby union — 英式橄榄球联合会
短语：rugby football — 橄榄球
短语：rugby league — n. 英式橄榄球联盟

bachelor
音标：英 /'bætʃələ/  美 /'bætʃəlɚ/
n. 未婚男子；获学士学位的人
短语：bachelor degree — 学士学位；大学本科学位证书
短语：bachelor of science — 理学学士
短语：bachelor party — （美）单身汉舞会（尤指婚礼前夕为新郎举行的）
短语：bachelor of law — 法学士；法律学士
短语：bachelor of art — 文科学士
短语：bachelor of engineering — 工程学士
例句：Gerald was 38, and a confirmed bachelor (=  a man who has decided that he will never marry  ) .
杰拉德38岁，抱定主意独身。
例句：The Crown Prince was Japan’s most eligible bachelor (=  a rich young man who has not yet married  ) .
皇太子是日本最理想的适婚男子。

bachelor’s degree
学士学位
例句：If you are under 26, a graduate with a bachelor’s degree or above, unmarried and have a stable job in Shenzhen, all you need is an identification card, education and working certificate.
如果你年龄在26岁以下，拥有本科及以上学历，单身未婚，并且在深圳有稳定的工作，你所需要的仅仅是身份证，学历证书以及工作证明就可以了。

routine
音标：英 /ruː'tiːn/  美 /rʊ'tin/
n. 常规；日常事务
adj. 通常的；例行的
短语：routine maintenance — 日常维修；例行维护
短语：routine work — 日常工作；常规作业
短语：daily routine — 日常生活；日常工作
短语：service routine — 服务程序
短语：routine analysis — 常规分析；例行分析
短语：routine examination — 常规检查
短语：routine operation — 例行操作
短语：routine test — 定期试验；常规试验；例行程序试验；定期测验
短语：routine inspection — 例行检查；常规检查；日常检验
短语：routine check — 例行检查；程序校验
短语：routine testing — 常规测试；例行检查
短语：working routine — 工作程序；操作程序
短语：complete routine — 完整程序
短语：executive routine — [计]执行例行程序；管理程序
短语：routine practice — 例行实作
例句：John’s departure had upset their daily routine .
约翰的离去打乱了他们的日常生活。
例句：Try to get into a routine (= develop a fixed order of doing things ) .
尽量养成一套习惯。
例句：my daily exercise routine
我每天的锻炼习惯
例句：Dressing is a task which we do every day as a matter of routine (= done regularly and not unusual ) .
穿衣打扮是我们每天必做的事情。
例句：You mustn’t worry. These are just routine enquiries.
你不必担心，这只是例行的询问。

minibus
音标：英 /'mɪnɪbʌs/  美 /'mɪnɪbʌs/
n. 小型公共汽车
例句：He was then taken by minibus to the military base.
接着他被小型公共汽车带到了军事基地。
